notes.title: GAMEPLAY & GALLERY UPDATE
notes.notes:
Howdy everyone! It's been a couple of months since our initial launch, however we've been reading the reviews and listening to feedback! In that time we've been busy working on a brand new update to address requests that you guys have made for the game. As such, we've got a juicy new update for you guys which we hope will make the game more enjoyable for many!

Changelog Dark Alley Elf v2.0 - 12/04/2019:

[h2]GAMEPLAY UPDATES:[/h2]
[list][*] Added a new "Story Mode" to the game!
[/list]
This mode leads you through a series of stages, collecting the money for the bet with Annabelle, instead of having to play the same stage multiple times. Each stage is different and handcrafted. Explore the roofs high above the city and dive deep below into the sewers!
[list]
[*] Turned the previous game mode into "Classic Mode"
[/list]
If you prefer to play the old mode on the giant map like before the update, you can choose "Classic Mode" when starting a new game. Of course, you can still unlock stuff in this mode, too!
[list]
[*] Added a "Gallery" option in the Main Menu!
[/list]
You can now view your favorite CG scenes and images again and again, provided you have unlocked them first! There's also a special version of the minigame for all the sexy fun, but without the consequences that come with it ;)


[h2]BUG FIXES:[/h2]
[list][*] Edited Lesath's daily dialogues and his Talisman Shop appears at the start of each day / stage. 
[/list]
Now you will get it even if you load the game, so you don't miss out on a chance of buying a talisman like before.
[list]
[*] Fixed a previous issue with advancing / closing Lesath's daily dialogue
[/list]
Previously only Y worked, now Z should work too like in every other dialogue.

notes.title: Release of Dark Alley Elf
notes.notes:
Hello everyone~

We just wanted to give you all a heads up that tomorrow, Tuesday the 16th of April, we will finally release Dark Alley Elf on Steam! That's less than 24 hours from now!

We are really excited and glad to finally be able to get the game out, and hope you are as well to play it and support us!

A demo version will also be available for download as soon as the game goes live, so look forward to that if you're still unsure!
The demo will include everything up to day three, where it will be cut short, to give you just a little taste~

Here's to a good launch!
~Projekt Wolfenstahl
